name: Indifference, Mass
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level adept 4, antipaladin 4, bard 4, inquisitor 4, lathspell 4, legendary ninja 4, mesmerist 4, psychic 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5
Targets one or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as indifference, except that it affects a number of secondary targets whose Hit Dice don’t exceed twice your level. If there are more potential targets than you can affect, you choose them one at a time until you reach the limit of HD you can affect. If you target only one creature, you ignore the spell’s HD limit.
